intro: Timberling Seeds are botanical kernels harvested from the agitated plant elementals inhabiting Teldrassil. Naturalists and druids study these seeds to understand why the forest's plant life has grown unusually aggressive.

p: The timberlings of Teldrassil are nature elementals whose temperament reflects the balance of the World Tree. Recently, these creatures have turned hostile and angry, troubling the night elves who tend the boughs. Herbalists like Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth believe the issue lies rooted in the soil, collecting seeds from wild timberlings in hopes that nurturing them under controlled, purified conditions might sprout docile offspring.
